content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Alpharetta

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your PMP Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-leadership experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria to ensure you meet education and hours-worked requirements before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp—an instructor-led course delivered entirely online. Attend sessions at your own pace across Alpharetta's work schedule, and engage directly with active certified practitioners who guide you through the PMBOK Guide and exam-focused content.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing bootcamp hours, create your PMI account and submit your PMP application directly to the Project Management Institute. Pay the required exam fee and await PMI's review of your credentials and eligibility verification.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and Q&A support—to build confidence. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner and complete the four-hour assessment on your timeline from any quiet location.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn 60 professional development units (PDUs) every three years to keep your PMP active. Granite PM Academy offers continuing education options to help you stay current and meet PMI's renewal requirements on schedule.
